text:
miriam: Quick copy/design pass for the connectivity gates in the Private setup flow. Punted a few phrasing options into Figma — https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/Private-Connectivity. Can folks skim? Hoping to lock microcopy before the next dev sprint (Mon).

alex: skimmed — high level looks good. One question: are we calling this step 'Connectivity gates' in-product? that's a little unfamiliar to customers. Could we use 'Network checks' or 'Connection checks' in the header and keep 'connectivity gates' as a dev-facing label somewhere else?

samir: From infra POV the UI is showing the actual runtime checks we run. I prefer 'Connection checks' or 'Network preflight' over 'gates'. Also FYI the check names need to reflect the implementation — e.g., we don't test every host, we test outbound TLS to control.redwood.com on 443 and an optional private agent port.

jess: a11y note: when checks run the status area must be a live region (role="status" or aria-live) so screen readers announce transitions. Also error messages should include an inline 'Learn how to fix' link and be reachable via keyboard focus.

miriam: good call. Proposed header text options (two variants):
1) "Connection checks" — short, customer-friendly.
2) "Network readiness" — slightly more formal.
Microcopy for failing state (two variants):
A) "Can't reach the control plane. Check outbound TLS to control.redwood.com:443. See help."
B) "Outbound connection blocked. Ensure your environment allows HTTPS to control.redwood.com on port 443. Learn more."
Which vibe do we want? concise vs instructional?

alex: vote for 1 + B. concise header but helpful failure copy. Also add a one-line helper under header: "Why we check this: the setup needs to reach our control plane to finish enrollment" — but maybe shorter: "This ensures the installer can contact Redwood to complete setup." Put that in a collapsible 'Why this matters' link so it doesn't add noise.

samir: Agree with alex's choice. Small engineering note: the UI should show the specific check name so logs match: e.g., "Outbound TLS to control.redwood.com:443" as the status label. If we use B copy, include an inline command folks can run for debugging:
```
# run from your bastion or jump host
curl -v https://control.redwood.com/healthz --connect-timeout 5
```
That helps support reproduce steps.

jess: Also: color/contrast: red error pills are currently #d73a49 in Figma — contrast is borderline with white text. Can we use darker red or add an icon + text instead of color-only state? Keyboard users need to tab into the failure row and hit Enter to expand details; make sure that interaction is documented in the design spec.

miriam: good catch re contrast. I'll update to #b22222 and add the chevron + error icon. For the expanded details panel I'll add a keyboard affordance: the whole row is a button with aria-expanded and focus styles. Also will add the help link that opens the troubleshooting modal.

samir: UX/behavior question — if a check fails we currently surface a 'Retry' button and a 'Proceed anyway' (for advanced users). Do we keep 'Proceed anyway' visible or behind an 'Advanced options' toggle? Security ops teams may be confused if casual users proceed.

alex: hide 'Proceed anyway' behind 'Advanced options' and require a short confirmation modal (two-step) if they click it. That should reduce accidental bypasses.

jess: For the confirmation modal, ensure the primary action is descriptive ("Proceed without connection" is clearer than just "Proceed"). Also include the consequences in plain language and ensure the modal is focus-trapped and returns focus to a logical place when dismissed.

miriam: summary / decisions to update in Figma:
- Header: "Connection checks"
- Failure copy: variant B (instructional) with inline help link and a sample debug command in docs
- Status labels mirror runtime checks: show "Outbound TLS to control.redwood.com:443"
- Error pill color -> #b22222 + icon, ensure contrast meets AA
- Make rows keyboard-focusable buttons with aria-expanded and aria-live for status changes
- 'Proceed anyway' behind Advanced options with a descriptive confirmation modal
I'll push these changes to Figma by EOD and tag engineering PR for copy.

deploy-bot: Note: design update scheduled -> figma file updated (comment added) — next: engineering copy sync requested. :rocket:

alex: thanks — once figma has the copy I can slot the text into the component library and run a quick visual test. If anyone has alternative microcopy suggestions post-update, drop them in this thread.

miriam: thanks all! leaving this open for any small wording tweaks; otherwise I'll close and move to ready-for-dev on Monday.
